### Downloads

| File                 | For                                                                              |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `…-x64-setup.exe`    | Windows 10/11 installer (recommended)                                            |
| `…-x64-portable.exe` | Windows, no installation needed; settings stay in your user folder               |
| `…-x64-portable.zip` | The same, unpacked: extract it anywhere and run `EZLauncher.exe` (starts faster) |
| `….AppImage`         | Linux: make it executable (`chmod +x`) and run it                                |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt`     | Checksums to verify the downloads                                                |

Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because the app is not code-signed yet. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

Minecraft files are downloaded from Mojang's servers, never bundled. EZLauncher is not an official Minecraft product and is not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
